verdicts.notes: Span is copper/banded Scrapper material matching the ground pipe (B4), no red. It hangs between the two crossarms with a small but visible droop at mid-span and reads as a hung line, not a rigid bar. Flatness is the owner's 2% sag on 5 cells, not judged. Minor, not a fail: each ground pipe stops ~0.2 cell short of its mast base; the join to the mast's grey riser is not drawn.

All 12 hose ends (3 tanks x W/E x upper/lower) end in a camlock coupler seated on a drawn dark adapter stub on the tank wall. No hose end is floating or stubbed into a plain wall. The census agrees: every end is 'coupled to <tank>'. The XTall frame crops the tank top (framing only).
